title: Minor esthetic bug : Black on gray text
body:
This "bug" was solved for carb entries #1376  but is still in preferences.

There are black "buttons" on gray background in the preference settings. It is very classy and chic but not the most visible combination.

![Screenshot_20220309-094910_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/157406584-2298b1bf-aa30-44e8-ba9a-1672a5c88ce4.jpg)

Same with Filtre on the top

The text color on buttons are based on `colorPrimary`. The night theming, is not using the default style correctly. This requires a bit of rework. There are some plans the cleanup and consolidate styling.

Its solved in the Themeswitcher branch for the light and dark mode. 
There must be planned to merge it in the future and apps has a real material theme and so we can change and adapt Color's as we want

Hi Andreas,

Are number picker fixed in your light/dark mode PRs (#1430 and/or #436) ?
(Horizontal is a bit better than vertical number, but none of bath are "perfect" currently)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/157862911-b731863f-f795-4360-8643-8e45a0a72685.png)

It's better on latest version but can be improved for numberpicker I think:
"-" is too small in horizontal number picker
"+" is not vertical centered (vertical and horizontal numberpickers), the bottom is troncated (vertical numberpicker) and has not same size (horizontal + bigger than vertical +) ...
